effect_description_eng:
[Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
[Main] [Once Per Turn] By placing 5 cards with the [Hybrid] trait from your trash under this Tamer in any order, you may digivolve this card into an [EmperorGreymon] in your hand for its digivolution cost as if this card is a level 5 red Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon gets +2000 DP. While this Digimon has 10000 DP or more, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
